snippet.title: Juvenile Power Fantasy v1.0 "Crash" Trailer
snippet.description:
Juvenile Power Fantasy is a gameplay mod where everything lives and dies super-fast, including you. It's sort of like Cory Whittle's old mods, as viewed through a funhouse mirror.

http://thekinsie.com/jpf/

Music: Tub Ring - When The Crash Happened
